info.title: Walk With Me API
info.description: Help widget for Savanna pages: grounded answers in Amharic and English, human help, jobs and alerts. Errors always use {"error": {"code", "message", "fix"}}.

post.summary: Ask a question; answers come only from the course, with citations
Open a human help request (the learner has previewed the place message)

get.summary: Read a help request and its messages (learner)

post.summary: Learner says whether the help was useful
Log a share consent event (time only, no content)
Learner sends a read-only page snapshot (needs an open request)

get.summary: Queue: open requests oldest first, then mine
One request: place message, chat, snapshot

post.summary: Ask the learner to share (they decide)
Resolve; the call-back number is deleted

get.summary: Filter values: job types, cities, supports (with plain labels)

parameters.name: supports

schema.description: Comma-separated support tags; every one must be offered
schema.title: Supports

parameters.description: Comma-separated support tags; every one must be offered

post.summary: Start an alert opt-in. Nothing is sent until it is confirmed
Confirm an SMS opt-in with the code
Stop all alerts for a phone number or chat
Draft the request text. Returns text only; stores nothing

get.summary: Questions asked at least K_MIN times in 7 days. No names, no ids
Messages the mock gateway would have sent (simulator only)
